Stamp Act, 1899 (as amended by Orissa Act no.1 of 2003 w.e.f 20.01.2003): s.35; Art.23 – Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 – Or.XIII r.8 – Impounding of a document (power of attorney) for insufficient stamp duty – Suit for partition filed power of attorney holders (PW-1) – During cross-examination of PW-1, appellants filed application under Or.XIII r.8 to impound the power of attorneys (POAs) on the ground that such POAs ought to be treated as conveyance within the meaning of Art.23 of Stamp Act as amended in Orissa State
